meta.description: Authored. Webhook-triggered, on-demand ROVER expand: the app's /api/rover/expand POSTs { approvalId, vtaNumber, appBaseUrl, ingestToken } here; this single polite fetch pulls the public VTADetails page (browser-like UA, on the VPN / AU egress) and POSTs its HTML to {appBaseUrl}/api/rover/ingest/ with the bearer token — the app extracts the inline PDFs, parses, archives and gates (PENDING). The ingest result is returned via Respond to Webhook. CRITICAL: the app never fetches ROVER itself; it only triggers this workflow. The token + base URL arrive in the PAYLOAD (the app reads them from process.env) — this n8n blocks $env access in Code nodes, and this keeps the workflow secret-free. Single fetch, no paging. active:false.
